subtitles.speaker: Char
subtitles.text: I've just calculated it. Earth's gravity will pull the rear half of Axis down.

subtitles.speaker: Amuro
subtitles.text: It's just a rock! I'll push it back with the Gundam!

subtitles.speaker: Amuro
subtitles.text: We won't know unless we try!

subtitles.speaker: Char
subtitles.text: Axis has already begun to fall!

subtitles.speaker: Amuro
subtitles.text: The Nu Gundam isn't just for show!

subtitles.speaker: Isamu
subtitles.text: ...I can't just sit back and watch this!

subtitles.speaker: Kaine
subtitles.text: We're going in too! Tapp! Light!

subtitles.speaker: Amuro
subtitles.text: Stop! Don't get yourselves involved in this!

subtitles.speaker: Neo Zeon Soldier
subtitles.text: The Earth's survival is at stake!

subtitles.speaker: Garrod
subtitles.text: I can't let Amuro be the only one who looks cool!

subtitles.speaker: Gainer
subtitles.text: What I do is my own business!

subtitles.speaker: Renton
subtitles.text: With Eureka by my side, I'm not afraid of anything!

subtitles.speaker: Barrel
subtitles.text: I... want to fight to the very end! That's okay, isn't it, Faye?

subtitles.speaker: Char
subtitles.text: In the end, sooner or later, nothing but sorrow like this will spread and crush the Earth.

subtitles.speaker: Char
subtitles.text: Then humanity must pass judgment on itself and atone to nature and the Earth.

subtitles.speaker: Char
subtitles.text: Amuro, why can't you understand this...?!

subtitles.speaker: Isamu
subtitles.text: Tch... It won't be that easy...!

subtitles.speaker: Gainer
subtitles.text: I don't want to die yet...!

subtitles.speaker: Tiffa
subtitles.text: It's the light of people's hearts.

subtitles.speaker: Gidget
subtitles.text: Huh? Ah! Axis is changing course!

subtitles.speaker: Talho
subtitles.text: We're not seeing things, are we?!

subtitles.speaker: Harry
subtitles.text: Axis's course change is confirmed! It's moving away from Earth.
